name: ha_trace
title: Automation and script traces for Home Assistant
description: Read-only step-by-step traces of automation and script runs on the connected Home Assistant instance: what triggered each run, which conditions passed or failed, which branches and actions ran with which data, how long each step took, and where and why the run stopped. Also returns not-triggered traces (a trigger evaluated a change but did not fire), which explain why an automation did not run. Returned as compact JSON in the domusops.trace/0.1 format, with times in the instance's local time. entities takes automation or script entity IDs or * patterns (automation.*, script.*_lights); without it, every automation and script is considered. start and end (ISO 8601; no offset means the instance's time zone) keep only runs that started in that window; without them, every stored run is returned. run takes a run ID from an earlier response; context takes a context ID from a ha_trace or ha_logbook_query response (the cause of an event) and returns every run in that context. Two context IDs match when their last 16 characters are equal. detail=summary gives one row per run; standard (default) adds every step, variable, result, and the configuration the run executed, losslessly, and is at least 3x smaller than the raw traces on a reference set (asserted in CI). A result larger than 100000 bytes (DOMUSOPS_TRACE_MAX_BYTES) is refused with the run count: use summary, run, context, fewer entities, or a shorter window. The instance keeps only the last few runs per automation or script (5 by default), and only automations with an id are traced; ha_logbook_query is the full history. Secrets, coordinates, and e-mail addresses are always redacted. Every response reports its compression_ratio. Requires DOMUSOPS_HA_URL and DOMUSOPS_HA_TOKEN (administrator user).

entities.description: Automation or script entity IDs, or patterns where * matches anything (automation.*, script.*_lights). Omit for every automation and script.

start.description: Keep runs that started at or after this time, ISO 8601 (2026-09-26T03:00 or 2026-09-26T03:00:00-06:00). Default when end is given: 24 hours before end.

end.description: Keep runs that started at or before this time, ISO 8601. Default when start is given: now.

run.description: A run ID from an earlier ha_trace response (32 hexadecimal characters). Returns that run only. Not combinable with entities, start, end, or context.

context.description: A context ID from a ha_trace or ha_logbook_query response, or a full 26-character context ID. Returns every run in that context. Not combinable with entities, start, end, or run.

detail.description: summary: one row per run. standard: every step, compressed losslessly.
